output_text: {"regions":[{"label":"Figure O.2 — A social contract for data founded on value, trust, and equity","kind":"diagram","bbox":[0.094,0.58,0.546,0.94],"summary":"Three interlocking hexagons present value, trust, and equity as foundations of a social contract for data.","details":"The diagram has three large colored hexagons arranged around a central orange triangular overlap labeled “THE SOCIAL CONTRACT.” The upper blue hexagon is labeled “VALUE” and states: “The full value of data materializes when systems enable the use and reuse of data for different purposes.” The lower-left green hexagon is labeled “TRUST” and states: “A trust environment is created when the rights and interests that all stakeholders have in data are safeguarded.” The lower-right purple hexagon is labeled “EQUITY” and states: “All share equitably in the benefits of data when investments and regulations create a level playing field.” Source printed below: “WDR 2021 team.”","limitations":"No directional arrows or quantitative values are shown."}]}
